review.official:
Former gardener from a
Columbian
city, joined
Rhodes Island
on
Silence's
referral.
Robustly talented, keen-witted, and ever lively no matter the secret mission she's on.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Small amounts of crystals distributed across surface of Operator's body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Per the Operator's description, we can determine her Oripathy fundamentally took gradual shape over the course of her frequent, varied contact with strangers. Owing to her healthy lifestyle, nevertheless, her condition hasn't notably worsened, and she will be receiving further treatment.

A short Liberi girl with a grin permanently plastered on her face.
Her conduct and manners are packed with deliberate good-kid acts that anyone can see through at a glance. Moreover, it's clear that she's fully aware of it herself, and she still does it on purpose with not the slightest intent of correcting the behavior; this is to the extent that Operators don't rumor her too well, though she doesn't seem concerned.
However, she hates being taken as a small child due to her height; this will quickly wipe away her facade to reveal the boiling anger beneath.

From Kafka's own perspective, she had no initial plans to join Rhodes Island.
Following the onboarding of Mountain and Robin, as well as Lotus, she intended to leave, but was deposited here by Silence.
The cause was her insistence upon keeping her Oripathy hidden from Silence, which was exposed at the time of her physical examination aboard Rhodes Island. Resulting dialogue within the Medical Department that day follows:
'Kafka, the entire time, I never realized you contracted Oripathy! Why did you not tell me!?'
'Tch. Busted, huh... I didn't wanna 'cause I KNEW you'd chew me out me like this...'
'Regardless, you're coming with me to the Medical Department for a checkup!'
'Wha? No, heck off! I'm going back to Columbia!'
'That's not happening.'
'Waaagh, stop pullin' me! I don't got the cash to get treated in a place like this!'
'I'll cover your costs. You have no cause to worry.'
'That ain't the problem here... aw, forget it, whatever...'
To sum up, once Kafka's exam results came out, under Silence's very firm demand, she ultimately agreed to stay at Rhodes Island, and in the end became an Operator.

After you realize Kafka's true identity, her good-kid act becomes a lot easier to explain.
In truth, beneath her guise as a gardener, she's wandered amongst the petty gangs of the city's underclass—as a gang member herself.
One could say, as an orphan, she grew up moving from place to place. One could say, as someone with gang dealings far and wide from childhood, she caught onto a survival philosophy of her own. That philosophy's embodiment—playing the good kid.
She absolutely does not care if people hate her for this mask of hers; really, it might make her happy. She doesn't want to be adored by very many, nor is she planning on adoring very many herself. This painstaking pretense is, as she sees it, the optimal tool for maintaining her sense of distance from others.
It's clear this approach stems from the day-to-day affairs of the gray zone—betrayal, deceit, bloodshed. In such surroundings, putting yourself first is the best approach.

When she received her second promotion, it caught us off guard that from Kafka's show of emotion, we could feel some kind of genuine sincerity.
It's understandable, though. All those who have paid a little attention to her can tell—when she'd just come to Rhodes Island, she was an artful dodger, unwilling to assume any responsibility. The present Kafka may well look the same as back then, but inside, she's long since changed.
She'll bring young children nice little surprises on the sly, and she'll aid those who need it without batting an eye; in off time between missions, she'll commonly show up in Perfumer's garden, and the two get along very well these days.
It's clear as day, she's found a place for herself in Rhodes Island now.
Just as we'd determined at the start, though life in the Columbian gray zone made her unwilling by nature to bare her soul to others, that nature itself was kind all along. It leads us to suppose, even, that she only took on such a nature to keep herself alive, disguising herself—cheating herself.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You give Kafka the work that needs doing, Doctor, and then I pass it all on... okay! This's just like how underground gofering goes!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Seeing as you're my friend now, Doctor, you can ask me for anything. Oh, but, apart from lending you my shears.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island's fulla all sortsa people I never met before. Everywhere I go, I sees what I wants. Hm? You're wonderin' WHAT it is I want? That's a secret, y'know. Secret.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm... still can't read your eyes. They're calm as a lake... But there'll come a day when I get your number, Doctor, just you wait!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, Silence kicked me out againnn! Hard times for a Kafka, sob, sob... huh? I started it by messing up her experiment? Aw, nerts, Silence got to you first... eh-hem, well, good talking, I'm just gonna mosey on out now!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Well, until I can get what I want, I guess I'll lend you a hand. Just lending it, though, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Story goes, I used to live in a real maaad kinda city, dealing with bad people alla the day. But then I came landship-side, and everyone's been some kinda nice with me, even givin' me snacks and all! Mm-hm, and that's why I like it here at Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: ...Y'know the secrets everyone tries their best to hide? They're like monsters, hidden in the dead shadows, waitin' for their chance. Beautiful... and dangerous. That's exactly why I do my darndest to collect them! Doctor, don't you got anything for my hoard?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, if you've ever got a problem, we can always call my 'friends' from Columbia in to help. Though you don't really gotta. One Kafka'll sort out all your troubles head to tail!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Bet you think I'm goofing off right now, Doctor. But I ain't.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Whatcha need me for...? Hey, hey, wait, no bean-spilling, not in front of everybody! Just treat me like a normal gardener, okay?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Just gotta figure what they're aiming for, and I can draw up some counterplans. C'mon, ain't I a wiz?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Seeing as you really need my power, Doctor, just c'mon and say it. Be like Kafka here, all serious and open, yeah?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Gardenin' or fightin', I didn't start doing either for compliments. But having my own efforts get noticed by you and the rest, well, that makes a Kafka real happy.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wonder what we can harvest this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just leave it to me. I guarantee you're all in for a fun time!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ah, thinkin' sucks... I guess I'll be listenin' to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Look at all these naughty li'l saplings. Ain'tcha cute... sit tight and Kafka'll trim ya up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Kafka, roger!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Right here, I guess.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hm-hmmm.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch your eyes... I see all your weakpoints in 'em.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You're all just hedges who know how to walk.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Lemme break ya right there.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Kafka knows you're scared. Tremblin' li'l bare branches.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Smooth sailin' just like always, Doctor. Alright, makes a Kafka wanna go get 'em!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Man, were those enemies pushovers. If I'd known sooner, I coulda saved a Kafka some effort.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, guess I gotta be more careful with the pruning next time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Whaddaya doing, Kafka... you can read their plans, can't you?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where's Silence's lab, again?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...Whaddaya think you're doin'.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, Kafka here wants to deck out your office with some bonsai. Don'tcha worry, I'll make 'em look real good.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, let's build us a snowman! First we roll up two big snowballs. We make the hat kinda round, then we do the clothes reaaal long... Ta-dah, one 'Doctor,' made to order! Oh, I dunno though, feels kinda sad seeing a Doctor all alone on the deck!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What work you got for me today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, birthday cake for you! See the flowers around the outside? Pure bespoke craft by Kafka hands. Careful you don't lose count counting 'em all, heheh! C'mon, yannow fine work like this ain't no sweat for me and my shears. Not that I got anything against working up a sweat for my best bud—hey, whoa, whoa, paws off! No eating yet! You admire the freakin' thing first!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Yannow, I've been here long enough to see all you Rhodes Islanders are real good people. And nothing gets me more heated than good people getting bullied. So if there's ever any bad guys you just can't handle, you drop me a line. A Kafka's always saving some secret sauce—what, no need? Fine. You're the boss, boss.
